component.name: quote
component.description: A blockquote presentation component for highlighting attributed quotations. Supports RTL/LTR direction, Large/Small sizes, and optional white background surface. Renders as a semantic <blockquote> with decorative quotation marks via CSS pseudo-elements. No interactive states.

source.note: Manifest filename contains a typo ('mainifest'). Preserved as-is per platform policy.

large.note: 846px is hardcoded in Figma. No Figma width variable found for Large size. Missing token: --quote-width-lg. Large is the default size — no modifier class required.

small.note: Figma maps Small to var(--Width-width-lg, 640px). Token name 'width-lg' for the 'Small' component variant is an inconsistency in Figma upstream token naming — preserved as-is.

none.note: No background is the default. No modifier class required.

root.description: Root element. position: relative to contain absolute pseudo-element quote marks. box-sizing: border-box.

body.description: Content area with horizontal inset padding (64px each side) for the quote body.

title.description: Optional heading text for the quote. Display font, weight 500, 24px/32px. Can be replaced with an <h*> element at the appropriate document heading level if semantic heading structure is required.

text.description: Main quote body text. Text font, weight 400, 20px/30px.

author-details.description: Author attribution container. justify-content: flex-end aligns the author block to the end of the row in both LTR and RTL.

author-info.description: Column stack for author name and description. align-items changes between LTR and RTL.

author-name.description: Author name. <cite> provides semantic attribution. font-style: normal overrides browser italic default. text-align: right in both LTR and RTL per Figma.

author-description.description: Author brief, title, or role. 18px/28px text font. text-align: right in both LTR and RTL per Figma.

variants.notes: 8 = 2 direction × 2 size × 2 background. All 8 produce distinct CSS output. No axis was discarded. RTL axis is NOT discarded because it produces layout and positioning deltas (unlike text-only components).

implementation_notes: Decorative quotation marks " and " are rendered via ::before and ::after pseudo-elements, not HTML. CSS content alt text ('/ ""') suppresses them from modern screen readers.
Quote mark positions differ between LTR Large, LTR Small, and RTL (same for both RTL sizes). Handled via .quote--sm and [dir='rtl'] selectors.
align-items uses physical values (flex-start/flex-end) per Figma. RTL overrides explicitly set flex-end on root, body, and author-info.
justify-content: flex-end on .quote__author-details is the same for LTR and RTL. No override needed. Physical right-alignment is intentional for both directions.
text-align: right on .quote__author-name and .quote__author-description is preserved for both LTR and RTL per Figma specification.
Root element is <blockquote> for semantic quotation. Author name uses <cite>. Attribution section uses <footer> inside blockquote.
No interactive states in this component. No hover, focus, pressed, or disabled CSS needed.
Large width 846px has no Figma variable. Token --quote-width-lg proposed and documented. Fallback 846px hardcoded.
Figma token --Width-width-lg (640px) used for Small. The 'lg' suffix for the Small variant is an upstream naming inconsistency — preserved as-is.
